<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugin-api/sync/sites"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Saves the site with an API key made on it, then mirrors its SSH hosts as read only hosts owned by the user who adds it, in a folder named after the site. The key's user on the remote decides which hosts exist here. shareRoles lists the roles the hosts are shared with.
